core_obligations: Part (1) (proof lines 21338-21368): unwinding the two functors on an etale sheaf over an object of (Sch/S)_etale gives pi_S^{-1}f_{small,*} = f_{big,*}pi_T^{-1}, which is a formal computation with the pullbacks.

Part (2) (proof lines 21370-21389): the canonical base change map pi_S^{-1}Rf_{small,*}K -> Rf_{big,*}pi_T^{-1}K may be checked after pulling back along i_g : Sh(S'_etale) -> Sh((Sch/S)_etale) for an object g : S' -> S; the pulled-back map computes as g_{small}^{-1}Rf_{small,*}K -> Rf'_{small,*}((g'_{small})^{-1}K) using pi_S composed with i_g = g_{small}, pi_T composed with i_{g'} = g'_{small} and the comparison lemma, and is an isomorphism by proper base change when K is bounded below with torsion cohomology sheaves.
Part (3) (proof lines 21391-21392): the same argument with the modulo n proper base change in place of the torsion one.

Part (4) (proof lines 21394-21411): for finite f both f_{small,*} and f_{big,*} are exact — the first by the vanishing of the higher direct images of a finite morphism, the second from the comparison lemma, since base changes of f are again finite — so part (4) reduces to the formal part (1).
proof_roadmap: Prove the underived comparison (1) by unwinding the two functors.

For (2) and (3), pull the canonical base change map back along an arbitrary object of the big etale site and identify it with the small base change map, which is an isomorphism by proper base change (torsion or modulo n).
For (4), use exactness of both pushforwards for finite morphisms, the big one via the comparison lemma applied to all base changes, and reduce to (1).
difficulty_reason: The lemma compares the small and big etale pushforwards for a proper morphism: an underived identity, the comparison for bounded below complexes with torsion cohomology sheaves, the same for complexes of Z/nZ-modules, and the finite case (statement lines 21322-21335). The two nontrivial parts are (2) and (3), where the canonical base change map is checked after pullback along an arbitrary object of the big site and identified with the small base change map so that proper base change applies (proof lines 21370-21392); part (4) rests on exactness of both pushforwards for finite morphisms, the big one being obtained from the comparison lemma over all base changes (proof lines 21394-21411). H2: two base-change verifications plus one exactness reduction, each written out.
